items.title: Vulcan Materials (VMC) Earnings Beat Keeps Undervalued Narrative In Play
items.summary: Vulcan Materials (VMC) just posted third quarter 2026 results that combined softer sales with a small earnings beat, a mix that helps explain the latest move in the stock. Vulcan Materials shares jumped after the Q3 report, with a 1-day share price return of 5.78% capping a 30-day gain of 15.47%. However, the year-to-date share price return is still down 4.22%, while the 5-year total shareholder return of 50.37% points to stronger longer term momentum.
